text_block_list.text: When I headed over to the training track...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
JOOOOORDAAAAAN!!
HOLD IT RIGHT THEEEERE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Why on earth are you painting your nails on the inside of the track?! That is strictly prohibited!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Bamboo-san, hold your horses.
I just gotta let the top coat dry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Just gotta dry' my foot! More importantly, did you really have to do your nails right here, right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, running with cute hands totally boosts your motivation, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Nail polish can protect your nails too.
Nail polish can protect your nails too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, look who knows their stuff.
You got nail care covered too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't tell me you secretly rock a clear top coat? Or are you into stuff beyond regular polish?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
............Um?
What are you even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, at this point, you gotta admit—
Bamboo-san, you totally need to get your nails done too, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! Where on earth did that leap in logic come from?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like in Reversi? You're sandwiched between two nail believers, so you gotta flip over!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way! It would just chip off the second I swing my shinai! I will pass, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then why not bling out your shinai instead?
Like, flip the script, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bling out my shinai?!
T-That thought never even crossed my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, someone's vibe matched mine!
Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't 'let's gooo' me! Blinging out a bamboo sword is going way too far!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... well, joking aside. Doing your nails seriously gets you hyped, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Interested in matching your racewear theme? I've got the exact right colors on hand, I can do it for ya!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Racewear design... Th-That certainly does sound like it would fire up my fighting spirit...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my nails are dry.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll teach ya next time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what?! You're not doing it now?! Hey, what is the deal with you—?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A-Are you being serious right now?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Blinging out... a shinai... sparkles...?
Dazzling the opponent's vision...?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That would be totally cowardly!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now *that* thought never crossed *my* mind!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, no point overthinking it—let's just give it a shot! Blinging out a shinai sounds so crazy it's got me hyped!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Where are you trying to drag me to~?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Right?! Sheesh, thank goodness someone said something!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aww, but it sounded so fun to customize!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Listen here! This shinai is the very manifestation of my soul!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A righteous blade meant to cut down breaches of public morals! To go and decorate such a cherished sword—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my nails are dry.
Heading back to training~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, hey, I wasn't finished talking! HOLD IIIIITTTTTT!!!
